key.name: mode
key.description: blocklist: suppress notifications only for the listed apps. allowlist: suppress notifications for all apps except the listed ones.

key.name: apps
key.description: Desktop app IDs (e.g. google-chrome.desktop) or WM_CLASS values the filter applies to.

key.name: recent-apps
key.description: App IDs that recently requested attention, newest first. Written by the extension and shown in the preferences for quick adding.
